SfdcPartnerOrderItem.name: SfdcPartnerOrderItem
SfdcPartnerOrderItem.description: Represents a line item within a partner order, including provisioning information and billing details from a customer's purchase, in a Partner Business Org (PBO).

CustomerUnitPricePerMonth.description: The customer unit price per month.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate), but not viewed it.

LineItemPeriodTotal.description: Derived field. The line item period total, calculated as CustomerUnitPricePerMonth * Quantity.

LineItemTotal.description: Derived field. The line item total, calculated as CustomerUnitPricePerMonth * Quantity * ContractTerm on the Order object.

Name.description: Auto-generated ID number for the order item.

PartnerOrderId.description: The associated partner order that this order item belongs to.

PartnerProvisionProductId.description: A provisionable product included in this order item.

PartnerProvisionProductName.description: Derived field. The name of the Partner Provision Product from SfdcPartnerProvisionProduct object.

PartnerPurchaseOrderNumber.description: Partner purchase order number for this order item.

PartnerTenantId.description: The Salesforce org ID that purchased products from the partner.

ProvisionedDate.description: The date and time when the order item is provisioned.

ProvisionedDateSyncStatus.description: The status of the provisioned date sync process.

ProvisioningStatus.description: Required. The provisioning status of the order item.

Quantity.description: Required. The number of units sold.

ServiceDate.description: The date range when the service is active. Used to assist provisioning.
